title: Text lists and quotations
description: Mark up paragraphs, ordered steps, unordered resources, definition terms, quotations and figures using their intended semantic elements.
objectives: Distinguish paragraphs from text containers and manual line breaks
Choose ordered, unordered and description lists by meaning
Represent an attributed quotation without inventing a source
Give a figure a useful caption independent of CSS styling
rubric: I used correct paragraph and list semantics for unordered resources and ordered steps.
I represented quotation and caption semantics without misusing them for styling.
I passed list-structure and attribution checks.
